sentences.text: Nachdem er gegessen hatte, ging er ins Bett.
sentences.en: After he had eaten, he went to bed.

sentences.text: Nachdem sie den Brief gelesen hatte, war sie sehr glücklich.
sentences.en: After she had read the letter, she was very happy.

sentences.text: Was hat sie gemacht, nachdem sie die Schule verlassen hatte?
sentences.en: What did she do after she left school?

sentences.text: Nachdem wir gegessen haben, gehen wir schwimmen.
sentences.en: After we've eaten, we'll go swimming.

sentences.text: Nachdem er nach Hause gekommen war, ging er sofort schlafen.
sentences.en: After he got home, he went straight to sleep.

sentences.text: Er kam erst, nachdem alle gegangen waren.
sentences.en: He didn't come until everyone had left.

sentences.text: Nachdem ich mit ihm gesprochen hatte, war mir alles klar.
sentences.en: After I had talked to him, everything was clear to me.

sentences.text: Kurz nachdem du gegangen warst, kam Robert.
sentences.en: Shortly after you had left, Robert came.

sentences.text: Nachdem sie ihr Geld verloren hatte, hatte sie nichts mehr.
sentences.en: After she had lost her money, she had nothing left.
